directive.quote: Port old trillion's Business screen one to one: find its old owner (src/business-screen.mjs, its catalogue row in records/marketplace-screens.json, and the account-routes screen) and what it read (connections, plus tool runs).

old_copy.deleted_with: old trillion 4ffa1dc4a2 (Retire old trillion's Worker and everything only it reached) already removed src/business-screen.mjs from its main line

preserve: only real figures: every amount is summed from entries the person's own payment service answered; a read that failed or took too long says so and shows no number; a read cut short at its limit says the figures count only the latest entries
amounts stay in each currency's smallest unit until they are written, and are never added across currencies
which services can be read, and how, is DATA (tools/money-reads/src/money-reads.json); a new payment service is a row there
businessFacts writes the words and figures the catalogue layout tool:business places, unchanged
allowed_deltas: the money read is a nested Workshop run through the run's door (invoke.records.runs), not the account action's runTool
the rows moneyServices reads are this folder's rows and the connect rows made from the service-connection descriptors, not loadWorkshopRows(env)
the person's connections have no owner a run reaches, so they are null (unknown): an unknown connection's money is read and a failed read is drawn as unread; given a list, it draws as before
the operator's part (payment config, call pool, price-test book: the hosted service's stores) has no owner here, so operatorBusiness and PAID_PLAN_TOOL are not carried; operatorFacts is
optionalRead (old src/optional-read.mjs) is carried in this file
banned_substitutions: a number for a read that failed
a service said to be connected or not connected without reading it
